class.name: JRPGClassData
class.brief_description: A class: how an actor levels up and grows.
class.description: Database entry for an actor class: the EXP curve, the parameter curves per level, the skills learned at each level and class traits. Curves and the EXP table are stored as integer tables so games never evaluate them at runtime.

method.name: bake_exp_table
method.description: Computes the EXP table from [member exp_base], [member exp_growth] and [member exp_extra] for every level up to [constant LEVEL_LIMIT] and stores it in [member exp_table].

method.name: compute_total_exp
method.description: Returns the total EXP needed to reach [param level] with the given curve values: [code]round(base * (level - 1) ^ (1.5 + growth / 100) + extra * (level - 1))[/code]. Level 1 needs 0 EXP.

method.name: get_exp_for_level
method.description: Returns the total EXP needed to reach [param level], from [member exp_table] when it is baked, otherwise computed.

method.name: get_param
method.description: Returns the value of [param param] at [param level], or [code]0[/code] when the curve has no value yet.

method.name: set_param
method.description: Sets the value of [param param] at [param level]. Max HP is kept between 1 and 9999, max MP between 0 and 9999, and the other parameters between 0 and 999.

members.member: Overall amount of EXP the curve needs: raising it raises every level's requirement.
EXP added for every level gained, on top of the curve.
How steeply the requirement grows at higher levels, from 0 to 100.
Baked total EXP per level: entry [code]L - 1[/code] is the EXP needed to reach level [code]L[/code]. Empty until [method bake_exp_table] is called.
Skills learned by level. Each entry is a [Dictionary] with [code]level[/code], [code]skill_id[/code] and [code]note[/code].
Parameter values per level for the eight parameters, [constant LEVELS] values per parameter. Use [method get_param] and [method set_param] to read and write them.
Traits shared by every actor of this class, as dictionaries with [code]code[/code], [code]data_id[/code] and [code]value[/code].

constants.constant: Number of values per parameter curve (levels 0 to [constant LEVEL_LIMIT]).
